profile.headline: Scientific software engineer and coastal dynamics enthusiast.
profile.summary:
I am a coastal geoscientist expecting Ph.D. in August, 2020 with 10+ years of experience in computer science and software engineering. I have a passion for communicating geoscience, which has led me to pursue minors in Computer Engineering and Educational Technology; I believe technology should be leveraged to support science research and promote sharing, discovery, and learning. 

My research focuses on computational methods in coastal science, including
--- Development and application of numerical coastal models and support tools
--- Integration of coastal models with geological field work and data collection
--- Data storage, discovery, and access techniques for scientific datasets
--- Development and application of educational coastal models

Outside of school, I enjoy distance running, hiking and camping, and cooking vegetarian meals. My goal is to work in a community-facing development capacity in the geoscience field.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
Supports research in the Coastal Geomorphology lab through field work, numerical modeling, and the development and application of software tools.

Current areas of research include
--- application of satellite imagery in numerical coastline modeling
--- use of interactive, visual numerical models in geoscience education
--- coastal storm response and recovery

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Spring 2019 Coastal Morphology and Processes T.A.
--- Designed interactive models demonstrating coastal processes and implemented in class workshops in which students experimented with physical processes using the models
--- Graded assignments and evaluations
--- Provided one-on-one help on assignments

positions.title: Scientific Software Developer Intern (Unidata)
positions.description:
--- Developed accessible Jupyter Notebook scientific data viewers (visualization tools) for the THREDDS Sata Server datasets.
--- Enhanced support for user customization/contribution for the THREDDS Data Server web interface.

company.name: UCAR - The University Corporation for Atmospheric Research

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
--- Enhanced the extensibility framework for VSTS version control and agile planning services by developing features such as an extension request service and reusable UI components for third party extensions.
--- Redesigned the VSTS notifications pipeline and implemented MustacheJS as a templating engine for email notifications to allow external extensions to utilize notifications.

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description: --- Designed and implemented a request monitoring system for Microsoft Application Insights, allowing users to track requests to their Azure applications using NodeJS.

positions.title: Explorer Internship
positions.description:
--- Engineered refactoring tools for the Visual Studio IDE to improve the developer experience.
--- Experienced three project roles: project manager, developer, and tester

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteers annually as a science fair judge at local elementary and middle schools.
Volunteers at annual Can You Dig It? geological sciences outreach event. Manages the wave tank exhibit and leads demonstrations on wave dynamics.
